methodology: Primary comparison: median of three independent process medians per version. Each process uses 8 warmup and 21 measured rounds per scenario. Pair order before/after, after/before, before/after. Positive delta means slower. Shared-process runs are diagnostic only because order affected JIT results. Promise counts were measured separately with async_hooks; absolute counts include harness overhead, deltas compare identical harnesses.

before.methodology: Both snapshots transpiled with the same TypeScript/ES2019/CommonJS settings. Identical in-memory stores and payloads; no cloning, network or I/O. Preparation excluded. Versions alternate; explicit GC between samples, GC during timing included. Refresh full-cycle includes the event-loop barrier and both store writes. Singleflight ns/op is per reader.
